long_description:
Physical operations still run on fragmented data, manual guard shacks, and paper lists that are difficult to verify. In yards and cross-docks across North America, facilities face surging cargo theft, strict compliance requirements (like CTPAT audits), and expensive labor bottlenecks. Moving from messy gate logs and high-risk manual workflows to fast, secure, autonomous access control usually requires breaking legacy systems or throwing more labor at the problem.

Supadock is the multi-agent AI platform for physical logistics operations. We help 3PLs, logistics businesses, and fleets automate facility workflows—starting with the gate. Our agents make sense of visitor credentials, validate documents via bank-grade KYC, identify security gaps, and automate the SOPs needed to secure facility perimeters 24/7, while keeping human oversight for operational exceptions.

Under the hood, Supadock is a multi-modal learning engine. We connect intelligence across your entire facility stack—orchestrating phone calls, emails, text messages, documents, cameras, access control gates, and TMS APIs. The system captures live operational context that compounds into a living model of your business, bringing multi-agent AI into physical logistics operations one SOP at a time.
name: Supadock
one_liner: Multi-agent AI for physical logistics operations
